title: Newmark Arranges Acquisition of 79,540-Square-Foot Industrial Facility in Aurora, Illinois
summary: Newmark announces the Company represented a national food company in the acquisition of a 79,540-square-foot industrial facility located at 3615 Exchange Avenue in Aurora, Illinois.
